note.item: Requires Joomla 5.4 or 6 and PHP 8.1 or later.

addition.item: First release of Pretty Slider: a slider with an image, title and short description per slide.
Slides from the articles in the selected categories, or manual slides that you create in the module with an image, title, description and link.
Optional button on each slide, with your own text, a choice of Bootstrap button classes and a custom class.
Class settings for the main div, the slide title and the slide description.
Setting to show or hide the slide description on small screens, and a setting to show or hide the pause button.
Settings for the number of slides, article ordering and direction, image priority, description source and length, and the title element.
Autoplay with a pause button and a setting for the seconds per slide. Autoplay does not start for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
Optional bullets at the bottom to go to a slide, and an optional line at the top that shows the time until the next slide.
